`openvr_driver.h` and `LICENSE.openvr` are from ValveSoftware/openvr tag
`v2.12.14` (BSD-3-Clause). Source:
https://github.com/ValveSoftware/openvr/tree/v2.12.14
No third-party runtime/client binary is bundled or launched.

The openvr.h client header URL and SHA-256 are pinned in openvr-client.lock.json (official Valve v2.12.14).
The optional background mirror helper dynamically loads the user-installed SteamVR client library; it does not download or start a runtime.
